questions.q: On which day of the week was the Prophet SAW born?
questions.explain: The exact date is not known, but the Year of the Elephant, a Monday and the month of Rabiul Awal are known with confidence.

questions.q: Who received the Prophet SAW at his birth?
questions.explain: He was born at full term and was received by Umm Ayman, the servant who looked after Aminah.

questions.q: What does the name Muhammad mean?
questions.explain: Muhammad means the praised one, from the same root as Ahmad.
Abdul Muttalib named his grandson Muhammad in front of the Kaaba. The name was rarely used among the Arabs then.

questions.q: Who was the Prophet's SAW wet nurse from Banu Sa'd?
questions.explain: Halimah came to Makkah looking for a baby to nurse and took baby Muhammad.

questions.q: Why were babies sent to the countryside to be nursed?
options: Because Makkah had no women who could nurse
Because the parents did not love them
Because the Kaaba was not suitable for babies
Because the air and water were clean and the Arabic was pure
questions.explain: The air and water in the village were clean and the Arabic there was pure, so the Prophet SAW had excellent Arabic.

questions.q: What did the angels wash the Prophet's SAW heart with?
questions.explain: When he was just over three years old, the angels opened his chest and washed his heart with Zamzam water.

questions.q: Abdullah died after the Prophet SAW was born.
questions.explain: False. Abdullah died in Yathrib when the baby in Aminah's womb was only two months along.

questions.q: Halimah took baby Muhammad even though nobody else wanted him, and her provision grew.
questions.explain: True. Halimah took the orphan baby, and her milk and livestock increased.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: Abdullah married Aminah and died, the Prophet was born, Halimah took him, and later his chest was opened.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A village woman who nurses a city family's baby
A child whose father has died
The village outside Makkah where the Prophet SAW was nursed

questions.explain: A yatim is a child who lost his father, khatan is circumcision, Banu Sa'd is the village where he was nursed, and a wet nurse is the woman who nurses the baby.

questions.q: A friend of yours has lost their father. Based on this episode, what should we do?
options: Take care of them, because orphans easily feel alone
questions.explain: Orphans easily feel alone, so they need to be cared for.
